correctness.rationale: A three-periodic vertex must be always resting or advance 0–1–2 each step. Connectedness excludes mixed behavior, giving the exact cyclic local successor condition. Every such coloring corresponds bijectively to a closed length-n walk of an explicitly given 81-state transfer. Exact integer SymPy characteristic factorization is \(X^{69}(X+1)(X^3-3X^2+2X-2)(X^4+X^3+2X^2+3X+4)^2\). Newton-power trace checks through \(n=18\) and independent direct synchronous simulation for \(5\le n\le11\) pass. The cubic discriminant is −104; all quartic roots have modulus at most two by scaled Eneström–Kakeya, establishing a unique leading rho>2. This is a complete infinite proof plus finite certificate, not numerical induction.
